description.value: Red Rock Grill is a locally owned and operated restaurant in 100 Mile House, BC, established in 2009 by a second-generation restaurateur born and raised in the South Cariboo. The kitchen turns out chef-prepared food made fresh daily — spanning creative small plates, burgers, mains, and pasta — alongside what the restaurant bills as the largest selection of BC craft beers on tap in town. It is a community-rooted, full-service stop for cyclists seeking a quality sit-down meal in the Cariboo interior.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at redrockgrill-100mile.com is fully active and confirms Red Rock Grill is an open, locally-owned sit-down restaurant in 100 Mile House, BC, with a detailed menu, catering service, and weekly specials. The phone number 250-395-1200 appears on the website but is absent from OSM tags, so it is sourced from the website. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags; however, the website explicitly states that items marked 'GF' can be prepared gluten-free, confirming that option.
concerns: Phone number 250-395-1200 sourced from website; OSM tags contain no phone field to cross-check.
OSM address ('725 Alder Avenue') lacks city, province, and postal code; website confirms the location is 100 Mile House, BC but does not restate the street address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible full-service restaurant with a confirmed website, detailed menu, and catering offering; a clear and useful dining stop for touring cyclists in the South Cariboo.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'Items marked GF can be prepared gluten-free'; GF designations appear across multiple menu categories including Small Plates, Salads & Bowls, and Mains
